description: Complete catalog of official public, governmental, school, bank, workday, Christian, and Hebrew holidays of Tunisia (تونس) — extracted from the vacanza/holidays Python library (MIT) algorithmic implementation. تونس/Tunis (Tunisia). No subdivisions — single national list.
